bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money to Interfaith Action for shelter operations and programming.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; EMERGENCY FAMILY SHELTER OPERATIONS AND PROGRAMMING. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Interfaith Action for operations and programming costs. Money may be used for shelter operations, case management, staffing, on-site support services, and programming to promote stability and self-sufficiency for families experiencing homelessness. This is appropriation is available until June 30, 2027. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money to Interfaith Action for shelter operations and programming.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; EMERGENCY FAMILY SHELTER OPERATIONS AND PROGRAMMING.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Interfaith Action for operations and programming costs. Money may be used for shelter operations, case management, staffing, on-site support services, and programming to promote stability and self-sufficiency for families experiencing homelessness. This is appropriation is available until June 30, 2027.
